equity.level_reason: Homelessness (SES) describes the cases and is named as a known risk factor; no results are reported by housing status, and the population is defined by injection drug use, which is not an SPD.

level_alternative.reason: Homelessness is set side by side for PWID and non-PWID cases (28 of 45 vs one of 19), which a lenient reading treats as group-specific results; no contrast is computed or framed as a disparity.

equity.equity_measurement: Homelessness and injection drug use are self-reported in the EMR; homelessness is compared only between PWID and non-PWID cases, with no non-case referent.

notes: Single-hospital case series; case counts are set beside a 19% rise in ED encounters and <2% rise in admissions to argue the increase is not due to volume. Xylazine exposure is self-reported or clinician-suspected; its role is inferred from timing with state overdose data, not analyzed.
view_issues: The 2023 count covers only 10 months, and EMR data are missing for October 28–November 23, 2020, because of a cyberattack.
